title: Fasting-glucose context of peak exercise heart rate fails to establish incremental cross-hospital CAD prediction
abstract: Fasting-glucose context of peak exercise heart rate did not establish incremental angiographic CAD prediction: Cleveland cross-validated Brier gain -0.004030; Hungarian external gain 0.000452, joint-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.008291, 0.004531]. A single glucose-flag-by-peak-HR term was added to flexible additive routine measurements in ridge logistic models trained in Cleveland (303 patients) and transported without recalibration to Hungary (284 eligible patients). Source cross-validation worsened;the external interval spans zero. This retrospective benchmark test is not untouched confirmation,equivalence evidence,or a clinical-utility study.
